review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. smart-base and the loader are byte-identical to the previous review, so nothing in the Smart base or the loading path moved. The Smart runtime changed in one place only: the closed size list of the checkbox, the radio and the switch now reads 1 and 2, matching the two rungs their stylesheets draw; before, size="1/3" passed the contract and produced a class no stylesheet defines, and size="2" was refused. Core raises the two default radii by one step of the scale — a control to 4px and a block to 8px — which no lesson describes.
